mapper.insert: insert into product(name, price, original_price, stock, image, category_id, discount, created_at, updated_at) values(#{name}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{stock}, #{image}, #{categoryId}, #{discount}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update product set name = #{name}, price = #{price}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, stock = #{stock}, image = #{image}, category_id = #{categoryId}, discount = #{discount}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update product set stock = stock - #{stock}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
